questions.question:
If A + B means A is the wife of B, A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B, A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B.

If P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M, then how is D related to H?
questions.solution:
Family Chart: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd8ae3409a7e80e7adb6a6adafb5ca1703115230729aa5a03a081d033c62e82.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 $
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife 
 Father
 Mother
 Brother 
 Sister 
 
 

 

Given: P ÷ D $ B + H × T - M

It means: P is the mother of D, D is the brother of B, B is the wife of H, H is the father of T and T is the sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bf4dfad5a2979802583ba16f4af6cbc960ea4326b4e9e10ebb52b21c8045001.png] 

So, D is the '**Wife's brother**' of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Wife's brother".

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All P are G.

Il. Some B are G.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some B are not P.

II. All G are P.

III. Some G are P.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
**Given **Statements:

I. All P are G.

Il. Some B are G.

The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e49bdd1c0018fe1d6f819188a4b5ec1e0c63d172a60f80480348282307707dee.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some B are not P. - **False **(Because, there is no relation between B and P, so it can be possible only)

II. All G are P. - **False **(Because, All P are G, so some G can be P but all G can never be P)

III. Some G are P. - **True **(Because, All P are G, so some G are P)

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

questions.question:
If 10 A 5 B 6 C 30 = 270 and 4 A 6 B 7 C 8 = 160, then

8 A 5 B 6 C 10 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01219c435f702a7f1fcbbff58b786753e42dec043aa26c103887f24c8f75c624.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Let A ⇒ ×, B ⇒ ×, C ⇒ -

10 A 5 B 6 C 30 = 270

⇒ 10 × 5 × 6 - 30 ⇒ 300 - 30 = 270

4 A 6 B 7 C 8 = 160 

⇒ 4 × 6 × 7 - 8 ⇒ 168 - 8 = 160

Similarly, 

**8 A 5 B 6 C 10 = ?**

⇒ 8 × 5 × 6 - 10 ⇒ 240 - 10 = **230**

Hence, the correct answer is **"230".**
